48sx.basis: Meanings from the system flag appendix of the HP 48SX Owner's Manual.

system.name: Principal solution
system.clear: QUAD and ISOL return the general solution
system.set: QUAD and ISOL return the principal solution only

system.name: Symbolic constants
system.clear: e, i, π, MAXR and MINR stay symbolic unless -3 is set

system.name: Numerical results
system.clear: Functions of symbolic arguments give symbolic results
system.set: Functions of symbolic arguments give numbers

system.name: Word size
system.field: Six flags together set the binary word size, 1 to 64 bits.

system.name: Integer base
system.field: DEC: both clear; BIN: -12 set only; OCT: -11 set only; HEX: both set

system.name: Coordinate system
system.field: Rectangular: both clear; polar/cylindrical: -16 set, -15 clear; polar/spherical: both set

system.name: Angle mode
system.field: Degrees: both clear; radians: -17 set, -18 clear; grads: -18 set, -17 clear

system.name: Negative underflow indicator
system.set: A negative underflow occurred (not trapped as an error)

system.name: Positive underflow indicator
system.set: A positive underflow occurred (not trapped as an error)

system.name: Overflow indicator
system.set: An overflow occurred (not trapped as an error)

system.name: Infinite result indicator
system.set: An infinite result occurred (not trapped as an error)

system.name: Function plotting
system.clear: For an equation y = f(x), only f(x) is plotted
system.set: For an equation y = f(x), y and f(x) are plotted separately

system.name: I/O data format
system.set: Objects sent as binary memory images

system.name: Receive overwrite
system.clear: A received name that exists gets a numeric suffix
system.set: A received name that exists overwrites the variable

system.name: Print line feed
system.clear: Line feed after each printed line
system.set: No line feed after printed lines

system.name: Clock display
system.clear: Clock shown only while the TIME menu is selected
system.set: Clock shown, ticking, at all times

system.name: Repeat alarm rescheduling
system.set: Unacknowledged repeat alarms are not rescheduled

system.name: Displayed digits
system.field: Four flags together set how many digits Fix, Sci and Eng show.

system.name: Number format
system.field: Std: both clear; Fix: -49 set only; Sci: -50 set only; Eng: both set

system.name: Level 1 display
system.clear: Level 1 may use up to four stack lines

system.name: Verbose messages
system.clear: Prompt messages and data shown automatically
system.set: Automatic prompt messages and data off

system.name: Fast catalog display
system.clear: Equation Catalog and the SOLVE and PLOT menu messages show equation and name
system.set: They show the equation name only

system.name: Alpha lock
system.clear: α once = one letter, twice = lock

system.name: User mode lock
system.clear: USER once = one key, twice = lock

system.name: Index wrap indicator
system.clear: Last GETI or PUTI did not wrap to the first element
system.set: Last GETI or PUTI wrapped to the first element
